headline_stat.name: units significantly direction-tuned during movement (ANOVA p<0.01)

stated_limitation: DANDI:000128 contains this single session for subject Jenkins (plus a spikes-only test split without behavior), so cross-session replication is not possible within the dandiset; population statistics across the 182 simultaneously recorded units provide the robustness here.

justification.dataset: MC_Maze (000128) M1/PMd delayed reaching in macaque Jenkins is the canonical dataset for reach direction/velocity tuning and appears on the known-good list.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, trials aligned to move onset, epochs and 50 ms binning correct, and the mm-vs-meter unit discrepancy in the NWB attributes is caught and corrected.
justification.analysis: Georgopoulos ANOVA/circular-PD/cosine fit, direction-conditioned speed tuning, lag cross-correlation, and a blocked-CV Poisson GLM with proper nested model comparisons are all appropriate and use circular statistics where required.
justification.correctness: Every headline number reproduces exactly from the committed final_run_log.txt, values are internally consistent with the figures and physically possible, with only a minor unflagged GLM non-convergence warning that does not change CV-stable conclusions.
justification.figures: Six clear figures with units, sample sizes, and effect visible (toward/away speed separation, cosine tuning, PD stability), with example units selected by effect strength rather than an unrelated criterion.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate, the modest median encoding r=0.36 is reported rather than the flattering example, and a specific real limitation (single session) is stated, though the near-flat toward-PD speed curve is described as an increase and GLM non-convergence goes unmentioned.
